title: What If Humans Could See 10 Seconds Into the Future?
description: A short production-engine test episode using original placeholder graphics and prerecorded narration.

scenes.narration: Imagine waking tomorrow with a strange new sense: ten seconds of the future, arriving before every decision.
At first, the gift would feel like a miracle. Traffic accidents could be avoided, dropped glasses caught, and every conversation anticipated.
But ten seconds is enough to change a life. When everyone sees the same future, the real question becomes who acts first.
